originalTitle: Salish's 12 Games of Christmas | Official Trailer | Netflix
content: Salish Matter and seven of her closest friends go head to head in 12 epic holiday challenges for a mountain of Christmas presents, with her dad, Jordan, as host. But there’s a twist: a Christmas imposter is hiding among them, out to sabotage the games and swipe the gifts. Can they unwrap the culprit before it’s too late? SALISH’S 12 GAMES OF CHRISTMAS arrives on Netflix November 28.
